evidence.observation: Exhaust oxygen was 3.3 ppm, consistent with the approximately 3–6 ppm post-purge baseline.
Oxygen increased to 11.6 ppm during growth.
Oxygen reached 32.4 ppm, a sustained departure from the established baseline.
Temperature 750.1 °C and Ar 99.6 sccm track setpoints; pressure is 759.9 Torr, heater power 44.3%, and status remains running despite rising oxygen.

args.missing_evidence: Independent oxygen verification and leak/inlet-gas checks are needed to distinguish air ingress from gas contamination, outgassing, or oxygen-sensor error; sample characterization is not yet available.
